user_saw: Editing an automation with an empty or whitespace-only command reported success and kept the old command scheduled, even when a simultaneous name change took effect.
summary: The fix rejects explicitly blank command replacements before contacting the Gateway or applying any edits.
reasoning: At the July 1 history boundary, cron edit already normalized blank commands away and only added replacement arguments to the patch when the normalized command was truthy. I checked the later whitespace-preservation change, whose diff and reported baseline confirm that it preserved the blank-command behavior. The older path history was blocked by a missing object, so I could not verify whether the defect shipped with command editing or appeared in an earlier regression.
